codeReview.summary: The fix adequately closes the prior restaurant thank-you alias gap without new code changes. The reviewed commit itself is unrelated, but the worker correctly proved that the existing `/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you` redirect already canonicalizes to `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you` through the route implementation, existing Playwright coverage, and live-browser evidence.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared route documentation remains inconsistent about which restaurant thank-you URL is canonical. Current runtime/tests/library treat `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you` as canonical, while the ADR still says `/restaurants/:slug/thank-you` is canonical.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/guest-routes.md:20 says `/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you` canonicalizes to `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you`; docs/adr/2025-12-03-guest-route-naming.md:17 says `/restaurants/:slug/thank-you` is canonical and `/restaurants/:slug/book/thank-you` is legacy; src/app/(public)/(marketing)/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you/page.tsx:8-13 and tests/e2e/guest-public-marketing.spec.ts:27-35 confirm the implemented canonical destination is `/restaurants/[slug]/book/thank-you`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The guest-routing-worker skill does not clearly say that a proof-only feature may be completed by validating existing route and browser coverage without adding a new RED test first, even though this mission used that path successfully.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: The feature handoff marks skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false because the worker validated pre-existing coverage instead of writing a new failing test; .factory/skills/guest-routing-worker/SKILL.md step 9 allows validated test-only coverage when behavior already satisfies the contract, but step 4 still reads as mandatory RED-first without this proof-only exception.

summary: Pass: the prior failure was specifically the missing proof for restaurant thank-you alias canonicalization, and this fix supplies that proof. I reviewed the original failing diff, the fix transcript/handoff, and both commits; the canonical redirect already exists in `src/app/(public)/(marketing)/restaurants/[slug]/thank-you/page.tsx`, Playwright already asserts the final canonical URL in `tests/e2e/guest-public-marketing.spec.ts`, and the worker also captured live-browser evidence showing `/restaurants/seed-perf-r001/thank-you` lands on `/restaurants/seed-perf-r001/book/thank-you` with the confirmation UI.
